title: 第九章 神奇作用第十章 武士三重
content_zh:
叶枫停下脚步，注意到了前方不远处的一块大石，越靠近那块大石，万古长青脉呈现出来的饥饿感就越强。
他三下两下的爬过去，探出头往这块大石头下方一看，大石底部，赫然有一颗青幽幽的拳头大小果子！
青柠果？黄阶下品灵药，看这火候，至少有十多年年份了。
叶枫心中一喜，随手摘了下来，正想将它扔入后背药篓，可就在此刻，手掌微微发热，握着青柠果的右手一条经脉产生了一丝吸力，将青色果子给吸住了。
淡淡的清凉气流顺着经脉没入体内，叶枫感觉丹田内劲多出了一丝，身躯力量也有了一些增长。
片刻之后，青柠果表面光泽变得黯淡了一点点，不过不仔细观察，这一细微变化根本发现不了。
要逆天了啊。
体内被元灵开辟出来的“万古长青脉”
，能自动吸纳丹药药力用以修炼不说，还能探知到附近药草的灵性，甚至直接吸收元气精华？
连最低等的黄阶下品灵药青柠果灵性都能感知到，黄阶中品、上品灵草的灵性更强，岂不是更难逃离“万古长青脉”
的魔掌？
叶枫心中激动可想而知。
不过，吸收了其中的元气精华，这颗青柠果还有用么？
大概已经废了吧！
虽然看起来品相还好，但实际只能算是一块卖相不错的药渣，甚至可能连普通的药渣都不如了。
如果说“探知灵性”
这一特性让叶枫激动的话，那么直接吞噬吸收药草中的元气精华这一点，更是让叶枫无限震撼。
是药三分毒。
元武大陆稍有常识的人都知道，灵草绝不能乱吃，必须经过特殊手法熬炼才会发挥作用。
基本所有药材都是如此，普通人吃下去是穿肠毒药，不但没好处，反而会因为消化不了药力导致腹痛，严重甚至会中毒而亡。

可是现在，不需要熬炼，万古长青脉直接吞噬药草中的元气精华反哺给了叶枫，使得叶枫的身体力量、内劲双双增加，却没有让他感觉到身体有任何不适。
这才是万古长青脉真正神奇之处。
将原本需要利用多种药物中和的药力，转化成适合普通人吸收的元气精华，是不是足以说明，自己日后不需炼丹就可以随意吸收天底下的任何药草？
意识到这些的叶枫心潮澎湃了。
原本他并不在乎寻找什么药草不药草，可现在精神劲儿却提了起来，将手中元气尽失的“青柠果”
content_en:
Ye Feng stopped and noticed a big rock not far ahead. The closer he got to the big rock, the stronger the hunger showed by the evergreen veins.
He crawled over three times and stuck his head out to look under the big stone. At the bottom of the big stone, there was a green, fist-sized fruit!
Lime fruit? Huang Jie's low-grade elixir, judging by its heat, must be at least more than ten years old.
Ye Feng felt happy and picked it off casually. He was about to throw it into the medicine basket on his back, but at this moment, his palm was slightly warm, and a meridian in his right hand holding the lime fruit produced a suction, sucking the green fruit.
The faint cool air flowed into the body along the meridians. Ye Feng felt that there was a little more energy in his Dantian, and his body strength also increased a little.
After a while, the surface gloss of the lime fruit became a little dull, but without careful observation, this subtle change would not be noticeable at all.
It's going to be outrageous.
The "Eternal Evergreen Veins" opened up by Yuan Ling in the body
, not only can it automatically absorb the power of elixirs for cultivation, but it can also detect the spirituality of nearby herbs, and even directly absorb the essence of vitality?
Even the lowest-level yellow-level low-grade elixir green lemon fruit can sense the spirituality. The spirituality of the yellow-level middle-grade and high-grade elixirs is stronger. Wouldn't it be more difficult to escape from the "Eternal Evergreen Vein"
The clutches of?
Ye Feng's excitement can be imagined.
However, after absorbing the essence of vitality, is this lime fruit still useful?
It’s probably useless!
Although it seems to be in good condition, in reality it can only be regarded as a good-looking piece of medicinal dregs, and may not even be as good as ordinary medicinal dregs.
If we say "exploring spirituality"
If this characteristic excites Ye Feng, then the fact that he directly swallows and absorbs the vitality essence in the medicinal herbs makes Ye Feng infinitely shocked.
It's three parts of medicine and poison.
Anyone with a little common sense in Yuanwu Continent knows that spiritual grass must not be eaten indiscriminately, and must be refined through special techniques to be effective.
This is true for basically all medicinal materials. If ordinary people eat it, it is a poison that penetrates the intestines. Not only is it useless, but it will also cause abdominal pain due to the inability to digest the medicine. In severe cases, it may even lead to death from poisoning.
But now, there is no need to refine it. The Evergreen Vein directly swallows the vitality essence in the medicinal herbs and feeds it back to Ye Feng, which increases Ye Feng's physical strength and internal energy, but does not make him feel any physical discomfort.
This is the real magic of the evergreen veins.
Is it enough to transform the medicinal power that originally required the use of multiple medicines to neutralize it into vitality essence suitable for ordinary people to absorb? Is it enough to show that I can absorb any medicinal herbs in the world at will without the need to refine elixirs in the future?
Ye Feng's heart surged when he realized this.
Originally, he didn't care what kind of herbs he was looking for, but now he became more energetic and took the "lime fruit" that had lost all its vitality in his hand.
